function.name: add_text
function.description: Write text or math on the whiteboard. Use ONLY for: titles, key formulas, equations, or labeled steps. Do NOT use for explanations—speak those out loud instead. Content auto-positions below previous items.

content.description: Text or LaTeX math. For math, use LaTeX notation: '\frac{-b \pm \sqrt{b^2-4ac}}{2a}', 'x^{2} + y^{2} = r^{2}', '\int_0^\infty e^{-x} dx'. For plain text: 'Quadratic Formula', 'Step 1: Factor'

size.description: large = titles, medium = formulas/steps (default), small = annotations

function.name: plot_function
function.description: Graph a mathematical function. Use this whenever you mention or explain a function—students understand better when they SEE the curve. Plot early and often: parabolas, sine waves, lines, exponentials, etc.

equation.description: Function of x. Supported: x^2, x^3, sqrt(x), sin(x), cos(x), tan(x), log(x), exp(x), abs(x). Operators: +, -, *, /, ^. Examples: 'x^2', 'sin(x)', '2*x + 1'

function.name: show_image
function.description: Search and display an image from the web. Use for anything visual that you can't graph: geometric shapes, unit circle, visual proofs, real-world examples, diagrams, 3D objects. If a concept is spatial or geometric, show an image.

query.description: Descriptive search query. Be specific: 'unit circle with radians labeled', 'pythagorean theorem proof with squares', 'right triangle SOH CAH TOA'

function.name: clear_board
function.description: Erase all content from the whiteboard. Use when switching to a new topic or when the board is getting cluttered.
